pkgmetadata.longdescription: Control, inspect, test, and record real shell sessions and full-screen terminal apps on Windows, Linux, and macOS. The CLI exposes the same terminal actions as the Rust, Python, and JavaScript libraries, and also runs an optional per-session daemon for AI agents that need structured access to terminal state. The Rust library and CLI use ghostty, rio, and xterm.js virtual terminals, and can record sessions to APNG/GIF/MP4 with the bundled JetBrains Mono font.
